Definition
[Morrey spaces] 1. ch7:7.46\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0176 For $1\leq p\leq \infty $, an integrable function $f$ belongs to $M^p(\Omega )$ if some $K$ satisfies \begin{equation} \tag {7.46} \int _{\Omega \cap B_R}|f|\, dx\leq KR^{n(1-1/p)} \end{equation} for every ball $B_R$. The norm $\| f\| _{M^p(\Omega )}$ is the infimum of such $K$.
